techniqueBudgetCurves.costSemantics: isolated nodesExpanded; cap spend is sum(min(observed nodesExpanded, cap)); use production workSpent for cross-technique allocation
techniqueBudgetCurves.censoringSemantics: a row is at risk at tranche start only when observed nodesExpanded exceeds the lower bound; exhausted rows leave at their observed frontier and budget-limited rows are censored at their observed cap
